title: Paseo worktree setup
description: Adds paseo.json, whose setup readies each new Paseo worktree by trusting and installing the mise toolchain, once Paseo has copied in the files .worktreeinclude lists. When any of that tooling is kept out of git, paseo.json is gitignored too and Paseo copies it from the source checkout into each new worktree; stack steps appended after it run through mise exec.
